purpose: Requirements for automatic selection of a document search backend (doc-link or doc-db) by the query-db and update-db wrappers, including ordering, fallback, index preparation, freshness and failure handling.
summary: Overview: wrappers auto-select an available backend so users need not know which is usable; index maintenance belongs to update-db wrappers
Scope and out-of-scope items, including doc-db install and KEY/series management exclusions
Preconditions defining what counts as an available doc-link and an available doc-db
Glossary of wrapper, doc-db, doc-link, ToC, DLID, KEY and series
Usage flow with ordered backend list, availability checks and fallback
Functional requirements FNC-001 to FNC-004: backend selection, query, update with DLID writing and backend designation, execution path notification
Business rules BL-001 to BL-007: selection order, index freshness, success vs failure, unprepared vs fault, series and result paths, backend designation, index population ownership
Non-functional requirements: observability, backward compatibility, responsiveness, availability, information protection
Error case table mapping conditions to behaviors
tasks: Designing or implementing query-db-rules and query-db-specs wrappers
Designing or implementing update-db-rules and update-db-specs wrappers
Implementing backend availability checks and fallback logic
Handling unprepared index approval and index building
Writing DLID to documents during index updates
Reviewing backend selection design or implementation against requirements
Writing tests for error cases and notifications
title: REQ-014 doc-db バックエンド選択 要件定義書
